layers.note: Layers inside a package need every file: run `scripts/graph/` in a checkout for layers and what triggers what

fixes.text: Run only what a change can reach: no path filters or affected-only selection on PR workflows
"ci-build / build-test-native-image (macos-latest)" runs 12 min in one job: shard it
8% of PR heads went green only on a rerun: track and fix flakes
A blocker most jobs wait on: "ci-build / build-shared" holds up 27 of 29 jobs, 29.0 job-min past their other needs; shorten it, or let them start setup and wait only for what they need
Jobs wait 82 s for a runner at p90: GitHub-hosted runners are often slow to start, so price a faster provider

notes.text: ci-doctor's guides are strongest for TypeScript and Rust. For Java it applies the principles, without a Java-specific page
